verdict.rationale: npm's own docs confirm it creates a lock file and keeps it usable when you switch registries. Nothing in the pack shows the file's format is documented, text-based, or readable and diffable by an agent. missing for 10: documentation of the lockfile format/schema, evidence the lockfile is plain text (e.g. JSON) that can be read and diffed, independent or hands-on corroboration of agent use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at a documented, text-based lockfile format it can read and diff

citations.quote: If you create a lock file while using the default registry you can switch to another registry and npm will install packages from the new registry
